description: Use this to find a resource id before get_quote or negotiate_price. Optional input: query, words from the name, path, or address; omit it to list what is for sale. Returns matching Sepolia resources with id, title, and URL. Does not quote, negotiate, or pay.

query.description: Optional words from the name, path, or address. Omit it to list every resource for sale.
